measured_by: raster: turning points of the linker's y(x) centreline, counted as sign changes of y(x+lag)-y(x) with the lag SWEPT from 3 to 10 px. No threshold is fitted to the expected answer (error class 27) and no single lag is trusted (error class 28): the count is the modal one and the sweep is reported so a reviewer sees the spread.
evidence: The linker is measured (3 carbons, so A5 is NOT A1). The two N-ethyls are read from the drawing and could not be measured at this raster's resolution, and the paper gives A5 no name, no formula and no mass, so there is no anchor orthogonal to the drawing at all. Mass cannot see connectivity -- and here there is no mass either.

measured_by: solved from two independent MALDI formulae -- T18U-PY12-A8 = C41H81N4O2S2 and T14-PY12-A8 = C37H75N4O2S2. Their difference, C4H6, is exactly T18U - T14, which is the cross-check that the solve is self-consistent.
evidence: A FORMULA IS NOT A STRUCTURE. C7H17N3 admits 1-(2-aminoethyl)-4-methylpiperazine, N-(3-aminopropyl)-N,N'-dimethylethylenediamine and many other triamines; nothing in the SI chooses between them, and A8 is the second-best and third-best lipidoid in the paper. DECISIONS.md D-2.
